name: plan-smith
description: Two-stage planning pipeline: the main agent distills conversation intent into a context packet, a clean-context plan-writer agent drafts the plan using a battle-tested reasoning-frame library and Opus/Fable-derived writing styles, and the plan is relayed to the user verbatim — no summarization loss, no context contamination.
